article.title: Reference to High Court under proviso to section 113.
article.content:
4AReference to High Court under proviso to section 113.

Order 46, Rule 4A
The provisions of rules 2, 3 and 4 shall apply to any reference by the Court under the proviso to section 113 as they apply to a reference under rule 1; and]

1 Ins. by Act 24 of 1951, s. 2.
